sloka: ते दीनमनसः सर्वे शुश्रुवुः काननौकसः ।वानरेन्द्रस्य निर्घोषं पर्जन्यनिनदोपमम् ।। 5.57.21 ।।।।
transliteration: te dīnamanasaḥ sarve śuśruvuḥ kānanaukasaḥ ।vānarendrasya nirghoṣaṁ parjanyaninadopamam ।। 5.57.21 ।।।।

translations.english: On hearing the loud voice of Hanuman, all the vanaras were longing to see their friend.
